scripts.lint: uv run ruff check services/core && uv run ruff format --check services/core && biome check apps
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy services/core/src && pnpm --filter @footnote/web typecheck
scripts.test: uv run pytest services/core && pnpm --filter @footnote/web test
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.start: pnpm build && uv run footnote serve
